Privacy Policy & Terms of Use

This page explains how CSCA International collects, uses, and protects user information, and outlines the terms under which this website and its services are provided.
By accessing or using cscainternational.com, you agree to the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use described below.
About CSCA International
CSCA International is an academic preparation and guidance platform created to help international students understand and prepare for the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA).
CSCA International:
• Does not conduct the CSCA exam
• Does not issue official CSCA scores or certificates
• Does not guarantee university admission, scholarships, or exam outcomes
All services and materials provided on this website are educational and preparatory in nature only.
Information We Collect
a) Personal Information (Voluntarily Provided)
We may collect limited personal information when you voluntarily submit it, including:
• Full name
• Email address
• Phone / WhatsApp number
• Country of residence
• Intended academic program
This information is collected only through:
• Contact or inquiry forms
• Mock test registration
• Counselling or academic guidance requests
b) Non-Personal Information
We may also collect non-identifying information such as:
• Browser type
• Device information
• Pages visited
• General website usage data
This data is used solely to improve website performance, content clarity, navigation, and user experience.
How We Use Your Information
Information collected by CSCA International may be used to:
• Respond to inquiries and guidance requests
• Provide CSCA preparation and academic readiness support
• Share relevant educational resources and updates
• Improve website content, structure, and functionality
• Communicate service-related information
We do not sell, rent, or trade personal information to third parties.
Cookies & Tracking Technologies
CSCA International may use cookies or similar technologies to:
• Analyze website traffic
• Understand user behavior
• Improve content relevance and navigation
You may disable cookies through your browser settings.
Please note that disabling cookies may affect certain website features.
Third-Party Services
This website may use trusted third-party tools for:
• Website analytics
• Form processing
• Communication services
These third-party services operate under their own privacy policies.
CSCA International is not responsible for data practices beyond its direct control.
Free Online CSCA Mock Test Disclaimer
The Free Online CSCA Mock Test available on this website is:
• A diagnostic and practice tool
• Designed for preparation purposes only
• Not an official CSCA examination
Mock test scores, feedback, or results:
• Do not represent official CSCA results
• Should not be interpreted as admission or scholarship guarantees
Educational Content Disclaimer
All content on cscainternational.com, including but not limited to:
• Articles
• Guides
• Blogs
• Handbooks
• Mock tests
is provided for educational and informational purposes only.
While we strive for accuracy and clarity, CSCA International does not guarantee that all information will always reflect the most recent university, institutional, or policy changes, which may occur without notice.
Limitation of Liability
CSCA International shall not be held liable for:
• Admission, enrolment, or rejection decisions made by universities
• Changes in CSCA or university admission requirements
• Outcomes resulting from reliance on website content
Users are strongly encouraged to verify official requirements directly with universities or relevant authorities.
Intellectual Property
All content on this website, including:
• Text
• Graphics
• Logos
• Handbooks
• Mock test materials
is the intellectual property of CSCA International, unless otherwise stated.
Unauthorized copying, reproduction, modification, or distribution of website materials is strictly prohibited.
User Responsibilities
By using this website, users agree to:
CSCA International reserves the right to restrict or terminate access in cases of misuse.
Changes to This Policy
CSCA International may update this Privacy Policy & Terms of Use from time to time.
Any updates will be published on this page and will take effect immediately.
Continued use of the website constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
Contact Information
If you have questions regarding this Privacy Policy & Terms of Use, please contact:
CSCA International
Email: info@cscainternational.com
Phone / WhatsApp: +92 315 1555507
Offices:
Islamabad & Lahore, Pakistan
CSCA International operates through physical offices in Pakistan and provides academic guidance services internationally through online platforms.

More Details

Start Your Global Journey

CSCA International is an independent academic preparation and guidance platform for the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA), supporting international students with structured readiness planning, mock tests, and CSCA-aligned study resources. We provide preparation and guidance only and are not an exam-conducting authority and do not guarantee admissions or outcomes. Our Pakistan offices are located in Islamabad (G-8 Markaz) and Lahore (Gulberg-III), with online guidance available for students across Asia, the Middle East, and Africa.
